# Spending the HKD a settlement brought in, the way a payment block cannot.
#
# The bill is settled by an ordinary transaction that names both bases — the
# payable's, and the HKD cash's — and the payment block then claims that
# transaction with `txn_guid:` instead of raising one of its own. This is what
# the refusal in fx_hkd_settled_in_then_spent_out.txt points the reader at.
#
# The arithmetic: 200.00 USD of payable booked at 1.40 is 280.00 CAD of cost to
# relieve; the 1,560.00 HKD paid for it cost 0.172, so 268.32 CAD of cash goes.
# The bill cost 11.68 CAD more than the currency spent on it, and that is the
# gain — measured against what the HKD *cost*, not against the payment day's
# rate, which is the whole reason the basis has to be named.
#
# What this fixture produces: 0.00 HKD available afterwards, an HKD account
# holding neither currency nor value, and `Income:FX Gain -11.68 CAD`.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_spending_what_a_settlement_brought_in.py.
2026-02-26 * "Pay US vendor out of the HKD account"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Liabilities:Accounts Payable USD 200.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "1.40"
		value: "280.00"
		cost_basis_split_guid: "{bill_basis}"
	Assets:Bank:HKD -1560.00 HKD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "HKD"
		share_price: "0.172"
		value: "-268.32"
		cost_basis_split_guid: "{hkd_basis}"
	Income:FX Gain $residual$ CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

bill "BILL-HKD-OUT"
	vendor_id: "V-US"
	currency: USD
	date_opened: 2026-01-05
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-05
		description: "Parts"
		action: "Materials"
		account: "Expenses:Supplies"
		quantity: 2
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-01-05
		due: 2026-02-05
		ap_account: "Liabilities:Accounts Payable USD"
		memo: "Bill BILL-HKD-OUT"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		date: 2026-02-26
		amount: 200
		bank_account: "Assets:Bank:HKD"
		txn_guid: "TXN_GUID"
		# The transaction carries two splits that are not the bank — the
		# payable and the realized gain — so which one settles the bill has
		# to be said rather than left to the order they happen to be in.
		txn_split_guid: "SPLIT_GUID"
		memo: "Payment for BILL-HKD-OUT"
